svg.text: Class diagram: system overview (all modules) · version 1.2 · 2026-11-13
Built from the code on the v1.2 branch (PR #9)
Class or Kotlin file of top-level functions («file»)
Each box lists a package's classes, interfaces, objects and enums by name.
Members are shown for the packages that changed in v1.2, in uml-v1.2-play.svg and uml-v1.2-app.svg.
core:play depends on core:verbs and core:cards; the other core modules stand alone.
A dashed arrow from :app means the app module depends on that core module.
